name: Peach Pie
subtitle: Fresh with cheesecake layer, from Aunt Lisa
notes: You can put this on top of a regular pre-baked pie crust, or try it with a short-bread crust.

steps.title: Make the cheesecake layer
steps.body: For the cheesecake layer, whip together: **1 cup sugar** and **8 oz softened cream cheese**.

steps.title: Add eggs and cinnamon
steps.body: Then add and whip again: **2 eggs** and **⅛ tsp cinnamon**.

steps.title: Bake the layer
steps.body: Spread over pie crust and bake at 400°F for 17-20 minutes.

steps.title: Make the peach topping
steps.body: Meanwhile, in a saucepan, mix together and stir until thickened: **1 cup water**, **1 cup sugar** and **3 Tbsp cornstarch**.

steps.title: Finish the topping
steps.body: Add vanilla, cool in refrigerator, then add **4-5 sliced fresh peaches**, and spread atop cooled cream cheese and pie crust.
